item.title: I Said One Sentence, and My Agent Did the Rest
item.description: My kid said he wanted to do origami. I sent my Agent a single sentence asking it to handle the origami materials. It searched for tutorials on its own, printed out the origami guide along with sheets of paper. Later I wanted a different color, so I told it again, and it reprinted everything. From “I want to do origami” to having the materials in hand — under five minutes.
